name: protocell-vesicle-control
description: The autopoiesis study negative control: IDENTICAL seed and process wiring to protocell-autopoietic (same static Gaussian-annulus phi seed, same Protocell process, same canonical D/k_decay/thr/dt/steps_per_tick) except production is knocked out via k_prod=0.0 -- collapsing rd_step's dynamics to plain decay+diffusion (see meta_modelers_guide/protocell/autopoiesis.py's rd_step docstring: 'k_prod=0 collapses this to plain decay+diffusion, the negative-control knockout'). Without self-production the membrane ring decays and its topological closure is lost well within the run window (observed < 150 internal steps in the Task-1 physics spike, well within this composite's first few ticks): enclosed_area -> 0 and persists -> 0.0, demonstrating that closure/persistence in the flagship composite is a genuine consequence of the autopoietic production loop, not an artifact of the seed geometry or diffusion alone. Protocell.__init__ explicitly restores any caller-passed 0-valued scalar config (k_prod included) that bigraph-schema's core.fill would otherwise silently refill from its non-zero _default -- so k_prod=0.0 here genuinely reaches the running process rather than reverting to the canonical 0.03.

provenance.source: task-3 autopoiesis-study negative-control build (identical seed/wiring to protocell-autopoietic; k_prod=0.0 matches tests/test_protocell.py's verified negative-control config)
